summary: The source archive selected only .py files under sdk/, so the bundled sdk/simulation/scenarios/*.json were missing and sdk.simulation.load_scenario("single-account") failed from a release.  Member selection now goes through release_includes(): root files, sdk/ Python sources, and sdk/ package data from an explicit extension allow-list (currently .json). Paths under tests/, test/ or __pycache__/ are left out. An allowed data file whose path looks private (hidden part, or a word such as secret, token, auth, capture, device, log) is refused rather than shipped or silently dropped, and sdk/ JSON must parse as UTF-8 JSON. Blobs are read before the archive is opened, so a refusal writes nothing. Archives stay byte-reproducible; the manifest and SHA256SUMS are unchanged apart from the larger file count.  Tests cover inclusion, exclusion of tests/docs/captures/untracked kinds, byte reproducibility with fixed tar and gzip metadata, loading a scenario from an extracted archive, the refusal guards, and a check that every tracked file in this repository passes the selection rules. Implemented by the release-engineer specialist subagent in an isolated worktree, independently reviewed by the verifier subagent (APPROVE), and re-validated by the parent.
